nodes.description: Address stored as the privileged owner of HodlerToken; set in the constructor and mutable only through setOwner.
Percentage of every transfer that is burned, default value 1.
Counter of registered hodlers, also used as the loop bound in _rewardHodlers.
Hard cap of 1000 * 10**18 tokens used to limit reward minting.
mapping(uint256 => address) enumerating every hodler address for reward distribution loops.
mapping(address => Hodler) used to check whether a recipient is already registered as a hodler.
HodlerToken constructor: sets owner = msg.sender, mints the initial 100 * 10**18 supply and registers the owner as first hodler.
setOwner(address _address) public, guarded by _onlyOwner, overwrites the owner state variable.
Overridden ERC20 transfer that burns a fraction of the value, registers new hodlers and triggers reward minting.
Overridden ERC20 transferFrom that burns a fraction of the value via burnFrom, registers new hodlers and triggers reward minting.
Private _rewardHodlers(address _from, address _to): loops over all hodlers, sums balances and mints proportional rewards up to maxSupply.
Public view _valueToMint() returning 10**18 or the remaining supply until maxSupply, whichever is smaller.
Public view isContract(address) using inline assembly extcodesize to filter contract addresses out of reward distribution.
Modifier _onlyOwner requiring msg.sender == owner before executing the modified function.
msg.sender, the externally controlled caller used for ownership, authorization and as the sender of transfers.
Privileged ownership reassignment performed in setOwner; full control of the contract passes to the new address.
Reward computation toMint.mul(balance).div(totalBalance) in _rewardHodlers; totalBalance can be zero, and rewards are minted in an unbounded loop.
Burn amount computed as _value.mul(burnRatio).div(100) and subtracted from _value in transfer/transferFrom.
_mint(hodler, reward) executed inside the _rewardHodlers loop, inflating balances and total supply up to maxSupply.
Parameter _address of setOwner(address _address).
Recipient parameter _to shared by transfer, transferFrom and _rewardHodlers.
Amount parameter _value of transfer and transferFrom; attacker controlled value feeding the burn math.
Source parameter _from of transferFrom and of _rewardHodlers.
Local toBurn = _value.mul(burnRatio).div(100) inside transfer and transferFrom.
Local finalValue = _value.sub(toBurn), the amount actually transferred.
Local toMint returned by _valueToMint inside _rewardHodlers.
Local totalBalance accumulated over eligible hodlers; used as the divisor in the reward computation.
Local balance of an individual hodler read during the reward loop.
Local reward = toMint.mul(balance).div(totalBalance) minted to a hodler.
Local remaining = maxSupply - totalSupply() inside _valueToMint.
Loop variable hodler holding each address from the hodlers mapping.
Local size returned by the extcodesize assembly block in isContract.
Inherited ERC20Burnable.burn(uint256) invoked by transfer and transferFrom to destroy the burned amount.

edges.reason: Constructor reads msg.sender to assign the owner and mint the initial supply.
owner state variable is initialized directly from msg.sender.
_onlyOwner compares msg.sender against the stored owner.
setOwner executes only if the _onlyOwner modifier passes.
setOwner writes the new value into the owner state variable.
setOwner triggers the privileged ownership reassignment operation.
msg.sender determines who is able to perform the ownership reassignment.
The ownership assignment operation ultimately overwrites the owner state variable.
The _onlyOwner modifier reads the owner state variable for its check.
transfer passes msg.sender as the sending account.
transferFrom uses msg.sender for the allowance check and approval update.
transfer invokes _rewardHodlers after moving and burning tokens.
transferFrom invokes _rewardHodlers after moving and burning tokens.
transfer computes the burn amount through the burnRatio multiplication and division.
transferFrom computes the burn amount through the burnRatio multiplication and division.
The reward loop performs toMint.mul(balance).div(totalBalance), dividing by a possibly zero totalBalance.
_rewardHodlers calls _valueToMint to determine the mintable amount.
_valueToMint reads maxSupply to compute the remaining mintable supply.
_rewardHodlers guard evaluates maxSupply minus totalSupply().
totalHodlers is the loop bound of both reward loops.
The reward loops read each address from the hodlers mapping.
_rewardHodlers calls isContract to exclude contract addresses from rewards.
transfer checks and registers _to in addressToHodler.
transferFrom checks and registers _to in addressToHodler.
transfer increments totalHodlers when a new hodler is registered.
transferFrom increments totalHodlers when a new hodler is registered.
transfer appends the new hodler address to the hodlers mapping.
transferFrom appends the new hodler address to the hodlers mapping.
transfer burns the computed burn amount through ERC20Burnable.burn.
transferFrom burns the computed burn amount through the inherited burn path.
_rewardHodlers mints the proportional reward to each eligible hodler.
The _address parameter is the new owner value accepted by setOwner.
The caller supplied _address parameter is written into the owner state variable.
The _to parameter is the recipient of transfer.
The _to parameter is the recipient of transferFrom.
The recipient parameter is forwarded to _rewardHodlers as _to.
The _value parameter is the amount processed by transfer.
The _value parameter is the amount processed by transferFrom.
The caller controlled _value feeds the burn ratio computation.
toBurn is derived from the caller controlled _value parameter.
finalValue is derived from the caller controlled _value parameter.
The _from parameter is the debited account of transferFrom.
The sender parameter is forwarded to _rewardHodlers as _from.
transfer computes the toBurn local variable.
transferFrom computes the toBurn local variable.
transfer computes the finalValue local variable.
transferFrom computes the finalValue local variable.
_rewardHodlers stores the _valueToMint result in toMint.
_rewardHodlers accumulates hodler balances into totalBalance.
_rewardHodlers reads each hodler balance into the balance local variable.
_rewardHodlers computes the per-hodler reward value.
_valueToMint computes remaining = maxSupply - totalSupply().
The reward loops assign each stored hodler address to the hodler local variable.
isContract reads extcodesize into the size local variable.
toBurn is the direct output of the burn ratio computation.
toMint is the numerator of the reward division.
totalBalance is the denominator of the reward division and can be zero.
The computed reward is the amount passed to _mint.
The owner address is explicitly excluded from the reward distribution loops.

normalization_plan.reason: The _address parameter only exists to supply the new owner value to setOwner.
The _to recipient parameter is consumed by the transfer flow and its hodler registration logic.
The _value amount parameter is consumed by the transfer flow and the burn calculation.
The _from source parameter belongs to the transferFrom flow.
toBurn is the result of the burnRatio mul/div operation and has no independent meaning.
finalValue is a transient intermediate inside the transfer body.
toMint is the numerator of the reward division performed by _rewardHodlers.
totalBalance serves only as the divisor of the reward division and can be zero.
The per-hodler balance is only used to scale the reward division.
reward is the value directly minted by _mint.
remaining is a transient intermediate inside _valueToMint.
The hodler loop variable only drives the reward distribution loop.
size only holds the extcodesize result used to filter contracts.
